_README: Where each part of the Hero Arm sits in the assembled arm.
Fed to scripts/pose.py, which bakes these into public/models/prosthetic-parts.glb.
model_part2 socket cup   the bottom, where the residual limb goes
model_part1 forearm      the main shell above it
model_part0 hand         fingers and palm, on top
'align' is the direction in the part's own space that should point up; run
python3 scripts/pose.py --axes <file> to get each part's principal axis.
